text.text_excerpt: I'd been wanting to try them for months and luckily for me I was down the street from this business watching the game Sunday with family and friends. The establishment I was in only had fries or grilled veggies to offer me but I wasn't having that. I called in, to I-tal Garden, and ordered the Mac plate. I wanted avocado fries as an app, but unfortunately they were out, so I got the crab less crab cakes instead. The food was soooo amazing I didn't even get a pic of it. I dove right in and couldn't stop eating! This will definitely be my new fav Vegan spot!

I went to I-tal Garden today. I got the build your own plate. BBQ jackfruit ribs, crispy cauli wings, mac n cheese, grilled veggies, and salad. I was full half way through my food but I'm not about that leftover business so I sucked it up and finished the plate like a champ. -BBQ jackfruit ribs are sweet and tender -Crispy cauli wings would be good for those that likes cauliflower. Sauce is also slightly sweet but not as sweet as bbq. -Mac n cheese was definitely cheesy. Not too salty. -Grilled veggies was normal grilled veggies -Salad came with a sweet sauce. I did not care for this at all. The mac n cheese was my favorite. I would definitely come back just for it.

This was the BEST bowl of anything I've had, period. The Nourishment Bowl and a chocolate chip walnut cookie saved me on a hectic work day in Treme. I stumbled upon I-tal when caught between appointments and in need of fuel. I was short on time so I popped in and ordered to go at the counter. There was a pretty decent lag in greeting/order taking but I'm giving them a break cause once I did get someone to take my order, he was funny and friendly. The food only took about 10-12 minutes and that gave me time to pop over to the plant store next door and buy some greenery. Overall, the food was AMAZING and I can't wait to go back and try more of the menu. The Nourishment bowl included a roast...
